$comment: Health and advisory rules (UX §B4, level 3 'Insights'). Each rule is evaluated over facts:, cfg: (effective config including pending), der: (derived), est: (performance estimates) and ctx:. Severity is info, warn, or critical. An action can be 'stage' (adds changes to the ledger as a user change), 'link' (an OS deep link), or 'focus' (jumps to a setting). Text templates interpolate {ref} values.

rules.title: DLSS Frame Generation is blocked by a Windows setting
rules.detail: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling (HAGS) is off. Your {facts:gpu.name} supports DLSS Frame Generation, but it needs HAGS.

rules.title: Estimated VRAM use is over budget
rules.detail: About {est:vramGB} GB of {facts:gpu.vramGB} GB. Expect stutter from texture streaming.

rules.title: Frame rate is limited by the CPU
rules.detail: CPU {est:cpuMs} ms vs GPU {est:gpuMs} ms per frame. Lowering GPU settings won't raise FPS. View distance and cars drawn ahead will.

rules.title: Frame cap is above the refresh rate
rules.detail: V-Sync limits output to {der:refreshHz} Hz anyway. Set the cap a little below the refresh rate for lower latency.

rules.title: Cap below the refresh rate to stay inside VRR
rules.detail: Your display supports VRR at up to {der:refreshHz} Hz. Above that, frames tear.

rules.title: Frame generation without VRR may judder
rules.detail: Generated frames pace best on a G-SYNC/FreeSync display.

rules.title: Rendered frame rate is too low for frame generation
rules.detail: About {est:renderedFps} fps is rendered before frame generation. Latency will feel high. Aim for 60 fps or more before generating frames.

rules.title: Turn on Anti-Lag 2 with FSR Frame Generation
rules.detail: It offsets most of the latency that frame generation adds.

rules.title: {der:recommendedUpscalerLabel} is available on this GPU
rules.detail: At the same render resolution it usually gives a sharper, more stable image than {der:activeUpscalerLabel}.

rules.title: Game threads are running on the CCD without 3D V-Cache
rules.detail: On the {facts:cpu.name}, only CCD {facts:cpu.x3dCcd} has the extra cache. Turn on Windows Game Mode and make sure the AMD chipset driver's core-parking service is running so the game is scheduled on the cache CCD.

rules.title: Game Mode is off on a hybrid CPU
rules.detail: Game Mode helps Windows keep the game's main threads on P-cores.

rules.title: Running on battery
rules.detail: GPU and CPU power are limited, so performance will be far below these estimates. Plug in for consistent frame times.

rules.title: GPU is near its thermal limit ({facts:telemetry.gpuTempC} °C)
rules.detail: Clocks may throttle and cause frame-time spikes. A frame cap reduces heat.

rules.title: Windows Auto HDR is changing this game's output
rules.detail: The game renders SDR, and Windows converts it to HDR. Exposure and post-process previews may look different on the desktop. The game has no native HDR setting yet (schema gap).

rules.title: Borderless mode without windowed-game optimizations
rules.detail: Windows composites borderless games, which adds latency. Turn on 'Optimizations for windowed games'.

rules.title: Side screen angle doesn't match your geometry
rules.detail: For {cfg:display.triple_screen.width} mm screens at {cfg:display.triple_screen.distance} mm, the angle should be about {der:tripleRecommendedAngle}°. The side screens will look distorted otherwise.
